title: The Unordinary Bible Study (TUBS)
subtitle: Monthly sessions cross-referencing biblical verses with active inference and process theology.
audience: Community members interested in inter-faith dialogue and the intersection of Active Inference with theology and contemplative traditions.
lede: The Unordinary Bible Study (TUBS) is a monthly Ecosystem session cross-referencing biblical verses with contemporary and inter-faith perspectives, connecting Active Inference to process theology.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Sessions read biblical passages alongside contemporary and inter-faith commentary, using Active Inference and process theology as a shared lens for discussion.

sections.heading: Participate
sections.body: Open to anyone interested in inter-faith dialogue, process theology, or reading scripture through an Active Inference lens.
